title: Figure 36. Recursive Filter Factor for Last Data Point (log-scale line graph)
description: Semi-log line graph plotting Recursive Filter Factor (0.001–1) against Number of Data Points in Sample (0–300). Curves are labeled F = 0.95, F = 0.98, F = 0.99, Index weighting, F = 0.995 and Equal weighting, with a side annotation "Filter memory fades faster ->". Text compares index-count-based fading filters with exponential filters. Captioned "Figure 36. Recursive Filter Factor for Last Data Point".
